issues: TS2305: Module 'expo-text-extractor' has no exported member 'extractTextFromImage' (src/lib/ocr.ts:13, __tests__/acceptance/m6.test.ts). The code incorrectly imports and calls TextExtractor.extractTextFromImage which does not exist according to the declared module; the mock also defines extractTextFromImage, but the real module type lacks it. Update OCR implementation to use the correct API (e.g., TextExtractor.extractAsync or define proper typings) and adjust imports accordingly.

M6 test failure: hidden category not found (expect hiddenCat toBeDefined). The test expects hidden categories to be included by getAllCategories, but getAllCategories filters out hidden categories unless includeHidden flag is true. The test calls getAllCategories without includeHidden, so hidden categories are omitted, causing hiddenCat to be undefined. Adjust getAllCategories to return hidden categories by default or modify the test to include hidden categories when checking.

OCR parseReceipt test failures: date parsing returned wrong dates for fixtures 5 and 7. The parser incorrectly interprets '2023/08/10' as '2023-08-01' and misidentifies merchant as date for fixture 7. The date regex and parsing logic need fixing to correctly handle YYYY/MM/DD format and ensure merchant detection does not mistake dates for merchant names. Update parseReceipt to correctly parse all supported US date formats and improve merchant extraction.
